info.name: TeamFlow API
info.description:
TeamFlow – multi-tenant Project Management SaaS (B7A6 Assignment 8).

1. Select the **TeamFlow – Local** environment (or set `baseUrl` to the deployed API + `/api/v1`).
2. Run the folders top to bottom: requests save `accessToken`, `refreshToken`, `organizationId`, `projectId`, `taskId`, `memberId`, `memberUserId`, `planId` and `transactionId` automatically.
3. Auth: collection-level Bearer `{{accessToken}}`; public requests use No Auth.
4. The member and admin folders log in as those users first; log in as the owner again afterwards.

request.description: Public sign-up always creates a TEAM_OWNER. Sending `role` returns 422.
Creates the account the owner will add as a TEAM_MEMBER.
The old refresh token is revoked. Re-using it revokes every session.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.environment.set('accessToken', d.accessToken); pm.environment.set('refreshToken', d.refreshToken); }

request.description: Requires GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID on the server (503 otherwise) and a real Google ID token.
Revokes the refresh token and clears cookies. Run 'Login (owner)' again afterwards.
Switches the collection to the TEAM_MEMBER.

exec: const pro = pm.response.json().data.find(p => p.name === 'PRO'); if (pro) pm.environment.set('planId', pro.id);
console.log('Open this URL in a browser to pay in the SSLCommerz sandbox:', d.gatewayUrl);

request.description: Open the returned gatewayUrl in a browser and pay with an SSLCommerz sandbox test card. The gateway then calls /payments/validate and /payments/ipn.
Normally called by SSLCommerz. The server re-validates val_id with SSLCommerz before activating anything; a fake val_id marks the payment FAILED.
